items.stem: Which ECR feature helps catch known vulnerabilities in container images?

options.rationale: Correct: ECR scanning detects known CVEs in images.
Tag length does not affect security scanning.
Public repos increase exposure, not security.

items.explanation: Correct: ECR image scanning finds known vulnerabilities.

items.stem: Which TWO apply least privilege to containers? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Assign IAM roles per task/pod (IRSA) scoped to needs
Restrict pod-to-pod traffic with network policies
options.rationale: Correct: network policy limits lateral movement.

options.text: Give every pod the node's full instance role
Run all containers as root with host access

items.explanation: Correct: per-pod roles and network policy enforce least privilege.

items.stem: Under the shared responsibility model for managed containers, who secures the application code in the image?

options.rationale: Correct: customers are responsible for their application and image contents.
AWS secures the underlying platform, not your app code.
The registry stores images; it does not vet your code.
Security is a shared responsibility, with the customer owning the app.

items.explanation: Correct: the customer secures the app in the image.
